services.name: Petrel Cruising Charters
services.desc: 2-6 Hours. About Petrel is a custom flush deck bass boat built at The Anchorage in Warren, RI. She is a traditional New England picnic boat. Ideal itineraries on Petrel include sightseeing, a picnic in Tarpaulin Cove, regatta spectator fleet a wedding launch or bachellorette party. Private Charters: Pricing is for the boat, not per passenger for private charters. Public Sails are $75 per passenger for a 2 hour sail. Petrel can accommodate up to 6 passengers for an unfortgettable adventure on Buzzards Bay. She is located at Brandt Cove Marina, 21 DuPont Drive, Mattapoisett, MA. More For all ages! • 2-6 Hours • Experience a traditional New England picnic boat!

services.name: Omoo Private Charters @ Cisco's
services.desc: Add a splash of sailing to your Cisco experience.

services.name: Intro to Keelboat - ASA 101
services.desc: 3 Days, 9am-4pm. About Upon completion of this course, participants wil be able to skipper a sloop-rigged keelboat of approximately 20 to 27 feet in length by day in light to moderate winds (up to 15 knots) and sea conditions. We will cover basic sailing terminology, parts and functions, helm commands, basic sail trim, points of sail, buoyage, seamanship and safety including basic navigation rules to avoid collisions and hazards. Auxiliary power operation is not required. More info Course details can be found at https://asa.com/certifications/asa-101-basic-keelboat-sailing/. What to Become a sailor. Learn the essential skills like hoisting sails, steering, and navigating safely.

services.name: Coastal Cruising - ASA 103
services.desc: 3 Days, 9am-4pm. About Able to skipper a sloop-rigged auxiliary powered (inboard or outboard engine) keelboat of approximately 25 to 35 feet in length by day in moderate winds (up to 20 knots) and sea conditions. Knowledge of cruising sailboat terminology, basic boat systems, auxiliary engine operation, docking procedures, intermediate sail trim, navigation rules, basic coastal navigation, anchoring, weather interpretation, safety, and seamanship. More info Course details can be found at https://asa.com/certifications/asa-103-basic-coastal-cruising/. What to bring Be sure to check Prepares sailors for independent cruising and navigating aboard larger boats

services.name: Bareboat Cruising - ASA 104
services.desc: 3 Days, 9am-4pm. About Able to skipper a sloop-rigged, auxiliary powered keelboat of approximately 30 to 45 feet in length during a multi-day cruise upon inland or coastal waters in moderate to heavy winds (up to 30 knots) and sea conditions. Knowledge of provisioning, galley operations, boat systems, auxiliary engine operation, routine maintenance procedures, advanced sail trim, coastal navigation including basic chart plotting and GPS operation, multiple-anchor mooring, docking, health & safety, emergency operations, weather interpretation, and dinghy/tender operation. More info The ASA Certificate for bareboat chartering

services.name: Coastal Navigation - ASA 105
services.desc: 1 Day, 9am-3pm. About Able to apply the navigational theory and practices for safe navigation of a sailing vessel in coastal and inland waters. On-water coastal navigation skills elements are contained in the ASA103, Basic Coastal Cruising, ASA 104, Bareboat Cruising, and ASA 106, Advanced Coastal Cruising, in progressively increasing levels of detail. More info Course details can be found at https://asa.com/certifications/asa-105-coastal-navigation/. What to bring Be sure to check the weather and dress accordingly. We recommend beinging sunscreen, a hat and closed-toe Classroom instruction in plotting and dead-reckoning using charts and tools.

services.name: Half-Day Lessons - ASA 111 - Customized Refresher Course
services.desc: 3 Hours. About Pricing is for the boat, not per student. A three hour sail dedicated to hands-on learning about how sailboats work. From rigging, to points of sail and corresponding sail trim, you will take an active role in sailing our training sloop with the ultimate goal of taking "Noel" out for a spin on your own. Please be at the launch dock 10 minutes prior to your scheduled departure. More info To access the fleet, you'll be taking a lunch or water taxi from the dock to your boat.
